streams.title: New characters
streams.summary: Nobuyuki Sanada and Takamaru are playable in testing. More than 90 others are on the wishlist.
streams.activity: Testing Takamaru's effects and musou, and Nobuyuki on his own skeleton.
streams.description: Characters from other Warriors games, added as new playable characters. Nobuyuki Sanada is the first and is playable in testing in his own character slot. Takamaru from Samurai Warriors 3 is the second and is now playable in testing too. The rest of the list is a wishlist, so the overall figure stays low until more characters are started.

substreams.title: Nobuyuki Sanada
substreams.summary: Playable in his own slot with his own Samurai Warriors 4 moveset, musou camera, effects, voice, art and weapons.
substreams.activity: Testing his model on his own Samurai Warriors 4 skeleton.
substreams.description: Nobuyuki is ported from Samurai Warriors 4 and has his own character slot on the Samurai 4 tab, so Kojirō is back in his usual place. He has his Samurai Warriors 4 model, cloth physics, stats, battle voice lines and all six weapons with their own weapon cards. His moveset is now fully his own, built from Samurai Warriors 4, with its musou camera, attack effects and musou kanji. His Triple Attack uses his three-tornado musou, and his musou cut-in has its own close-up. His attack ranges, projectiles, effect colours, musou camera and horseback animations now follow Samurai Warriors 4 and are being tested. His model now runs on his own Samurai Warriors 4 skeleton instead of one adapted from another character, keeping his original twist joints for the arms and sleeves, his own cloth physics and properly drawn hair strands. This is in testing. He has one outfit, his Samurai Warriors 4 one. Still to come: fine-tuning against Samurai Warriors 4.

substreams.title: Samurai Warriors 4
substreams.summary: 96 Samurai Warriors 4 outfits, including DLC outfits, all with cloth physics, sit in their own Xtreme Costume slots.
substreams.activity: Fixing clipping and seams, with hair and capes now drawn properly.
substreams.description: Every Samurai Warriors 4 outfit for the Samurai Warriors characters in this game is being brought over, including DLC outfits, with several per character. 96 are built, all with cloth physics, and sit in their own Xtreme Costume slots alongside the originals, marked with their own icon in the costume list. They are rebuilt at full quality with shine matched to the game's lighting, see-through pieces such as glasses are drawn properly, and cloth now clips less against the body. They are being tested.

substreams.activity: Checking every menu and mode with Nobuyuki in his new slot.
substreams.description: New characters get their own slots beyond the game's built-in limit, with room for hundreds. Nobuyuki is the first to move into one, which puts Kojirō back in his usual place. Characters in these slots can be picked, fight, level up and save, have their own weapons, and work in Musou Battlefields, Triple Attacks, the Gallery, Duel and Gauntlet.

substreams.summary: A Samurai 4 tab on Character Select and Duel, with Nobuyuki in it.
substreams.activity: The Samurai 4 tab is in on Character Select and Duel.
substreams.description: New tabs on the character select screen, starting with Samurai 4 for Nobuyuki and later Samurai Warriors 4 characters. It works on Character Select and Duel; the Gallery is next. Other tabs haven't been decided yet.

substreams.title: Costume slots
substreams.summary: Ported outfits get their own Xtreme Costume slots, and characters can now have more outfits than the game's limit.
substreams.activity: Testing several Xtreme Costume slots per character.
substreams.description: Ported outfits sit in their own Xtreme Costume slots in the costume list, alongside the originals, with several per character. Characters can now have more outfits than the game's built-in limit, and new characters like Nobuyuki get outfit slots too.

streams.title: Improved graphics
streams.summary: Filmic colour, ambient occlusion, sharper textures, softer character shadows and skin, and no more screen flashing on camera pans.
streams.activity: Trying the new HD stage textures, bounce lighting and better hair and eye shading.
streams.description: The mod uses its own graphics add-on. Working in game: smoother edges, stronger light shafts, sharper and softer-edged shadows, shadows from stage scenery, filmic colour, ambient occlusion, a second layer of distant fog, sharper textures at an angle and on distant soldiers, softer character shadows and skin, and less colour banding. The brief screen flashes during camera pans are fixed. Performance, Balanced and Quality presets switch these on together. Shadows no longer pop in on some stages, and hair has a new shine. HD textures for every stage have been built. Reflections on water and bounce lighting are being tried next.

streams.title: Ultrawide screens
streams.summary: Menus, movies and loading screens now fit 21:9 and 32:9 screens, and the game starts at the chosen ultrawide resolution.
streams.activity: Ultrawide support is ready for a full play-through.
streams.description: Support for 21:9 and 32:9 displays. Menus and Officer Select sit in the centre of the screen, movies and loading screens keep their shape with borders at the sides, and the game starts at the ultrawide resolution you last chose. A full play-through is next.

streams.title: Larger battles
streams.summary: Battles can now hold up to 1,000 characters instead of 180. The busiest stage reached 999, all armed, with no slowdown.
streams.activity: Raising the number of characters drawn at once in the biggest battles.
streams.description: The game normally limits a battle to 180 characters, so soldiers disappear and reappear as others spawn. The limit is now 1,000, and the busiest stage reached 999 characters, all armed, with no slowdown. Characters are also drawn further away. Crashes found in the busiest battles have been fixed, and musou close-ups now show in big battles. Gameplay testing comes later.

screenshots.alt: Nobuyuki Sanada surrounded by a large crowd of soldiers while the camera pans across the battle
screenshots.caption: A battle with the 1,000-character limit. 32 seconds, no sound.

streams.title: Installer
streams.summary: A one-file installer with a launcher, downloading the mod data and an optional 4K texture pack.
streams.description: A one-file installer and launcher that patches a copy of the game, including the menu music, and can download an optional 4K texture pack. It is in testing and not released yet.

streams.title: Named officers become new characters
streams.summary: Named officers in battle, such as Nobuyuki Sanada, will appear as the new characters with their own model and moves.
streams.activity: Looking at how named officers are set up in the game data.
streams.description: Many stages have named officers who aren't playable, such as Nobuyuki Sanada. The plan is for them to appear as the new playable characters instead, with their own model and moveset. The game already does this for a few characters. This comes after the new character slots, since each new character needs a slot of their own first.
